contradicting_evidence: Positive settled BTC flows and currently positive participation could support a more durable recovery than the mixed forecast allows.
BTC and ETH have positive 90-day returns in the supplied altseason dataset; recent weakness does not establish a uniform longer-term contraction.
Stablecoin supply contraction does not prove selling, and no confirmed market breakdown is supplied.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Expect an uneven week in which BTC support and selective altcoin rebounds compete with ETH flow weakness and contracting stablecoin supply. Renewed retests remain credible, but a one-way decline is not established. A broad recovery would require the current participation improvement to persist and ETH-relative strength and flows to improve; BTC resilience alone is insufficient.
falsification_conditions: Sustained joint price recovery, improving ETH/BTC, persistent broader participation and improving settled ETH flows would weaken the downside-sensitive mixed outlook.
Failed BTC stabilization together with persistent ETH-relative weakness, negative participation and weakening settled flows would favor a directional decline.
A durable expansion in participation and liquidity deployment, rather than one positive snapshot, would invalidate the expectation of limited transmission.
missing_evidence: Several additional settled ETF sessions and refreshed stablecoin observations covering the forecast period.
A sustained ETH/BTC and capitalization-participation sequence establishing whether relative improvement persists.
Updated macro developments and usable catalyst context.
Evidence supporting any timed cycle transition; no such transition window is supplied.
supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply contracted approximately 0.68% over seven days and 1.67% over 30 days, leaving the observed liquidity backdrop less supportive of broad expansion.
The latest settled session combines positive BTC ETF flows with negative ETH ETF flows, supporting differentiated rather than uniform market direction.
Only 12 of 49 measured altcoins outperformed BTC over 30 days, with the median altcoin return approximately -9.49%; one positive day does not repair that relative weakness.
The structural context records a prior rebound that failed to hold. Current positive hourly observations do not yet demonstrate a durable reversal of that pattern.
